outcome: rate of SARS-CoV-2 infection in parturient women
prevalence of maternal COVID-19 IgM and IgG antibodies
prevalence of neonatal COVID-19 IgM and IgG antibodies
transfer of IgG antibodies to neonates
cohort: The study participants were asymptomatic, low-risk, non-immunised pregnant women admitted to a tertiary hospital, and their newborns.
finding: The rate of positive PCR for COVID-19 among asymptomatic low-risk parturient women was 1.2%, with about a quarter of women exhibiting positive IgG antibodies indicating prior infection and immunity, which was transferred to almost all neonates.
cross-section timing: during the nadir period of new cases
